claim: On the Imperial Gazetteer of India map 'Madras (Southern section) with Mysore, Coorg & Travancore' (Bartholomew, Oxford 1907-1909, vol 18 opposite p. 250, scale 1:4,000,000 per the map's own legend), Tiruppur is a named place in Coimbatore district, drawn east of Coimbatore beside the Noyil River and north of Palladam, in the same type size as Palladam and Kangayam; railway lines are drawn through the Coimbatore-Erode area.

evidence.locator: map image, Coimbatore district, zoomed crop

notes: Read by eye from the image: whether the railway station dot sits exactly on the line was not resolved at this resolution, so do not say the map shows the railway at Tiruppur. The DSAL index page gives the scale as '1:6,000,000. 1 in. to 94.6 miles' while the map's own legend reads 'Scale 1:4,000,000 or 63.1 Miles to an Inch'; the two disagree, so no scale is quoted. Whose map: a British-Indian government publication, so a colonial record of what was drawn. Background only.

claim: The Tiruppur district official Tamil page spells the city name in Tamil script as திருப்பூர், and says the city excels in the ready-made garment industry, is the 7th largest city in Tamil Nadu, and that about 20 lakh people live in and around it.

evidence.quote: இம்மாநகரம் ஆயத்த ஆடை தொழிலில் மிகவும் சிறந்து விளங்குகிறது. தமிழகத்தில் ஏழாவது பெரிய நகரமான திருப்பூர் ... சுமார் 20 லட்சம் மக்கள் வசிக்கிறார்கள்.
evidence.translation: This city excels in the ready-made garment industry. Tiruppur, the seventh largest city in Tamil Nadu ... about 20 lakh people live in Tiruppur and its surroundings.

notes: Closes the R3 open item on Tamil-script spelling (C517). The population and rank are undated page text; use the Census figures already in the ledger instead. Translation is mine; a Tamil reader should check.

claim: A Tamil Nadu government district text (reproduced on Vikaspedia, source line 'Tamil Nadu government website') says Tiruppur's knitwear exports rose from Rs 10 crore in 1984 to Rs 11,000 crore in 2006-2007.

evidence.locator: Vikaspedia Tamil page Tiruppur, industry section
evidence.quote: பின்னலாடை உற்பத்தியில் 1984ல் ரூ.10 கோடி ஏற்றுமதியில் இருந்த திருப்பூர் 2006-2007ல் ரூ.11,000 கோடியாக உயர்ந்துள்ளது.
evidence.translation: In knitwear production Tiruppur, with Rs 10 crore of exports in 1984, has risen to Rs 11,000 crore in 2006-2007.

notes: Hedge: the original tn.gov.in page (http://www.tn.gov.in/ta/district_view) returned 404, so this is a mirror by CDAC-Hyderabad. It agrees in size with the Textile Commissioner's Rs 10 crore for 1985 already in the ledger but gives 1984, a year earlier; the two are not the same measure necessarily. Do not narrate the year without hedging.
